description: Front door not latching; tenant disclosed an ex-partner holds a key. Same-day lock change.

history.note: Emergency lock change raised. Tenant given 999 and National Domestic Abuse Helpline (0808 2000 247).
Escalated to Joanne Mills (safeguarding lead), P2. Record restricted.
New euro cylinder and latch fitted, 3 keys handed to tenant. Old cylinder removed.
Key safe code changed; new code sent by SMS to +447700900140 only. Tenant confirmed. Landlord informed by email under emergency authority, no personal details.
Spoke with tenant. Support in place. Safeguarding flag stays on the record; I remain case owner.
